name: 45050 · Monroe, OH
findings: ZIP 45050 (Monroe) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45050 (Monroe) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45050 (Monroe) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
